assessment.scope: Selected Van Oers2020/online2019 original and ESM1, original RIVM2016 ReportI mineral chapter and appendix, Vieira2016 article/S2/S4, Berger2020 assessment and Ericsson2019 dissent. The2017 revised-report metadata/erratum and prior limited table observation retain their actual scope; no full new2017 PDF reading or uninspected correction text is claimed. ReCiPe journal pp138–140 was rechecked for the corrected opening.
assessment.comparison: Equal1kg elemental extraction is a factor comparand, not common product service. Geological-stock depletion, average future additional ore per currentkg and future采选cost indicators answer different questions.
